description: Valid cases carry a complete value. Invalid cases name a valid base case of the same section; replace the top-level keys listed in patch, then remove the top-level keys listed in omit. A producer that does not know when a request was created reports the start time of the request's turn as createdAtEpochMs, a lower bound that a receiver uses only for ordering and fences.

retention.description: A receiver keeps at most retainedRequestsPerThread records per thread, ordered by the earliest createdAtEpochMs of the turn among the kept records, then turnId, then order, then id. Beyond the cap it drops the oldest closed records first, then the oldest open ones, orders what is left again, and reports the thread as truncated until the next reset or epoch change. For every dropped record it keeps a version fence per turnId and id, at most retainedFencesPerThread, and ignores a later record of that key unless its version is higher. Beyond the fence cap it forgets the fences with the lowest createdAtEpochMs first; from then on a record of an unknown key that is pending or submitting and was created at or before the latest forgotten fence is ignored when it arrives as a push and accepted when it comes from a pull of the current backend state, while closed records of unknown keys are always accepted. Fences apply to pulls and pushes alike. A pull clears neither the fences nor the forgotten range; only a reset or epoch change does.
